concepts.name: neuron
concepts.definition: An excitable cell that receives, processes, and transmits information through electrical and chemical signals.

concepts.name: excitable_cell
concepts.definition: A cell capable of generating and propagating electrical signals.

concepts.name: dendrite
concepts.definition: A structure of a neuron that receives incoming signals.

concepts.name: cell_body
concepts.definition: The part of a neuron that integrates effects on the membrane potential.

concepts.name: axon_initial_segment
concepts.definition: A region of the axon where sufficient depolarization triggers voltage-gated sodium channels to open.

concepts.name: axon
concepts.definition: A long projection of a neuron that conducts electrical impulses away from the cell body.

concepts.name: voltage_gated_sodium_channel
concepts.definition: A channel that opens upon sufficient depolarization to initiate an action potential.

concepts.name: action_potential
concepts.definition: An electrical signal that travels along the axon as successive regions of membrane become depolarized.

concepts.name: potassium_current
concepts.definition: A current involved in helping the membrane return toward its resting state after a spike.

concepts.name: sodium_channel_availability_change
concepts.definition: A change in the availability of sodium channels that helps the membrane return toward its resting state after a spike.

concepts.name: myelin
concepts.definition: A substance that insulates the membrane between nodes of Ranvier in many axons.

concepts.name: nodes of ranvier
concepts.definition: Small exposed regions on an axon where action potentials are regenerated.

concepts.name: saltatory conduction
concepts.definition: A process that carries signals rapidly along an axon via regeneration at nodes of Ranvier.

concepts.name: electrical signal
concepts.definition: A signal within one neuron that must influence another cell for information to move through a circuit.

concepts.name: arrangement

concepts.name: chemical synapse

concepts.name: presynaptic membrane
